messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Saturday 17 Jan
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's DMS (FileSite) will be unavailable from 20:00 to 23:00 on Saturday 17 January for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any open documents before then. Email and Teams are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
